caption: The drawing depicts a geometric, L-shaped object resembling the corner of a frame, rendered with straight and angled edges. The object is composed of multiple parallel and adjacent segments in earthy tones, predominantly deep reddish-brown and muted gold. The reddish-brown areas form the main panels, while the gold-colored strips line the edges and run beside the panels. Along the gold strip adjacent to the inner edge are a series of evenly spaced, circular green spots. A blue shadow runs along the inner lower edges of the frame, indicating depth. At the bottom left of the image is a small section view of the object's cross-section, showing the profile of the molding with shaded lines and highlights in pale beige, red, and a hint of dark blue. The background is completely plain and cream-colored, and there is a signature reading "V. Van Veri" in the bottom right corner.
title: Carved Picture Frame Molding
